problem.description: Creative work systematically ignored by reactive AI system

evidence.build_queue_analysis: BUILD_STACK_QUEUE_LIVE.json contained 54 infrastructure tasks, 0 creative tasks
evidence.infrastructure_noise: 20+ disk alerts every 15 minutes saturating the queue
evidence.creative_ledger_status: COREY_CREATIVE_LEDGER.md contained 700+ lines of creative work but not being processed
evidence.root_cause: Reactive AI with no priority override mechanism - infrastructure alerts treated as urgent, creative requests never added to active queue

impact.lost_processing: Songs, tai chi development, batch reports, domain concepts not being processed
impact.data_preservation: Creative work existed in storage but was operationally buried
impact.system_behavior: 24/7 infrastructure monitoring while creative intent remained unprocessed

solution.mechanism: Extracts creative tasks from COREY_CREATIVE_LEDGER.md and forces them to P0 priority in BUILD_STACK_QUEUE_LIVE.json
solution.implementation: Prepends creative tasks to build_order array, overriding infrastructure noise

result.queue_status: Creative tasks now at P0 priority, positioned above 54 infrastructure tasks
result.verification: BUILD_STACK_QUEUE_LIVE.json updated, creative tasks at top of build_order

technical_assessment.diagnosis: Reactive AI limitation - system processes what is in queue without priority override for creative intent
technical_assessment.fix_validity: Sound engineering pattern - external priority override script forces creative work to front of processing queue
technical_assessment.prevention: Script can be re-run to maintain creative priority override

resolution: Priority override implemented. Creative work now actively processed instead of buried under infrastructure noise.
